problem_type: Repeated reasoning rows in process projection
symptom: Five reasoning disclosures interleaved with four tool receipts
direct_cause: Each thinking item is appended then sorted back to its original receipt-level index
class_root: No per-process cardinality and lifecycle invariant for reasoning disclosures
internal_only_reason: User-specified Nomi presentation invariant; upstream evidence is recorded in the C77 plan.
invariants: A running process has no thinking child rows; a settled process has at most one, before all tools, with full ordered text.
generality_proof: All tool-bearing stretches use this shared projection, independent of provider, history source or number of reasoning parts.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Normalize process children and retain receipt identity

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Calls collapseV4Flow for live and restored laneViewModel items.
Calls collapseV4Flow with explicit turn timing.

recurrence.reason: Every multi-step reasoning/tool turn can reproduce the same rows.
same_class_scan: rg collapseV4Flow src: useAgentPanelV4Data and b2cFormFixtures
rg thinking src/workbench/ai/lane/laneViewModel.ts: live/restored thinking mapping
AgentPanelV4Panel recursively renders every process detail via V4FlowRow

prevention.invariant: No live thinking children; at most one settled disclosure before tools.
prevention.failure_mode: Intermediate reasoning parts cannot escape as separate child rows.
prevention.strategy: Replace per-part projection and source-position sorting with ordered tools and one merged thought.

legacy_paths.rationale: Remove append-every-thinking and re-interleave sort behavior.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Internal pure UI projection; no SDK version changes required.

migration: Derived view only; persisted thinking and tools remain unchanged.
residual_risks: Real-provider latency is outside this deterministic loopback UI verification.

invariant_owner_layer.why: Shared process projection owns lifecycle and child cardinality.
